content.short: Cwallet is a multi-chain wallet and crypto toolkit with social tools for payments, swaps, tips, and airdrops.
content.description: Cwallet combines wallet functions with exchange, payment, and community tools across web, mobile, and social platforms. Official product pages describe support for holding, sending, receiving, swapping, and buying crypto, along with bots and features for tipping, airdrops, giveaways, and other group workflows. Within the TON app set, it fits as a wallet and utility product for users who want to manage assets and run crypto activity directly inside social channels, communities, and chat based campaigns.
content.meta: Cwallet brings wallet, swap, payment, tip, and airdrop tools together for TON users who operate across apps, groups, and social channels.
